title: Concept: FreeMarker template error returned to a client
description: A FreeMarker template error with its file and line in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The error names the template file and the expression, which shows how server data is bound into the page and where a value the attacker controls is used.
applicability: Deployments that render a FreeMarker template error with its file and line into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The error names the template file and the expression, which shows how server data is bound into the page and where a value the attacker controls is used.
